findings.finding: New `.ccg/reviews/*.json` files (review artifacts with sha refs, backend names `claude`/`opencode`, decision metadata) are added to the repo; these must never be version-controlled.
findings.rationale: .gitignore 第 536 行注释与 scripts/check-pr-exec-record.js 的读取面共同证明 JSON 是设计中的机械留痕，不是误入库；本条指控与仓库既有约定冲突。

findings.finding: Global `.mp-panel input/select/textarea` selectors in `page-controls.css` apply to every element with `.mp-panel`, not just the five target pages, risking unintended style bleed.
findings.rationale: 实测 grep：mp-panel 仅出现在 6 个目标组件；非目标页不使用该类名。将控件规格绑定在 mp-panel 内是契约设计而非意外全局泄漏。

findings.finding: `01-docs/PRD.md` edit splits the word incorrectly (`被` then newline then `umberValue`) and only removes a trailing space; the broken table row remains unfixed.
findings.rationale: 已修复：恢复后对比父提交的 diff 只包含新增附录（`git diff HEAD~1 -- 01-docs/PRD.md` 中无该行增删）；历史损坏行保持原样、未被本次改动扩大。

findings.finding: Five new CSS files (~1600 lines total) are imported unconditionally in `main.js`, adding global CSS overhead to all pages, not just the five targets.
findings.rationale: 构建产物共 44 个 CSS、873KB 未压缩（含全部既有样式）；新增 5 文件占比小且为静态解析成本，对桌面端无实际性能影响；拆包加载会引入 FOUC 与额外工程复杂度，不划算。

findings.finding: Review JSON artifacts expose internal backend names and internal review decision metadata (`decidedBy`, `stagedDiffHash`, `sensitiveContentHits`).
findings.rationale: 与 i1 同源：这是既有约定而非本次新增暴露面；本次两个 JSON 中的字段与既有 2403 个文件结构一致，无凭证/个人信息。

findings.finding: `PodcastChannelView.vue` and `PodcastHostingCard.vue` delete their entire scoped `<style>` blocks; not every deleted selector has a verified 1:1 replacement in the new global CSS.
findings.rationale: 逐 selector 对照完成；视觉证据：五页截图 + `podcast-channel` 浅/暗基线重建后 pixel suite 20/20 通过，未出现「有结构无样式」。

findings.finding: `page-scaffold.css` introduces `mp-page-inner` with hard `max-width` (1240px/1440px); existing non-target pages may rely on different container limits.
findings.rationale: 实测 grep：mp-page 仅 4 个目标视图；mp-page-inner 仅随 mp-page 出现。最大宽度是页面骨架契约的一部分，不影响未接入的页面。
